text:
Nikhil: raising a docs PR to add a small troubleshooting section for on-prem installs where HSM libs fail to load under strong lockdown. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/3301

Erin: Can you include a tiny troubleshooting checklist: permission, selinux, systemd flags (PrivateTmp/NoNewPrivileges), and common PKCS#11 paths? That helped a customer last week.

Nikhil: Yep. Plan: short checklist + two inline snippets (stat check and systemd drop-in) + a note about not bundling large vendor libs in the airgap tar.

Carlos: For the airgap note, add a recommended approach: put HSM vendor libs on internal repo and mount them into the installer chroot, or reference via package mirror. Also mention multipart uploads and a checksum file for large tarballs.

Nikhil: Snippets added: `stat -c "%a %U:%G %n" /opt/hsm/libpkcs11.so` and systemd drop-in example: `[Service]
EnvironmentFile=/etc/redwood/installer.env
PrivateTmp=false
# If using SELinux, ensure proper context: sudo chcon -t textrel_shlib_t /opt/hsm/libpkcs11.so`

Erin: small wording nit: call out the installer flag rename in v0.9.4 (`--enable-private-dns`) and say older installs should set the same flag in /etc/redwood/installer.env to preserve behavior.

ops-bot: preview deployed: https://deploy-preview.redwood.io/3301 1 changes

qa-bot: Quick link check: docs/kms/proxy-config vs docs/kms/old-proxy mismatch found. Replaced with proxy-config and added a redirect in the docs site config.

Carlos: Can someone validate this in a semi-airgapped lab with nftables? I can spin up a node but need the test checklist.

Erin: I'll run a smoke verify tomorrow: install with PrivateTmp=false, apply selinux chcon, ensure pkcs11 loads and that the installer falls back to KMS proxy when HSM is temporarily unreachable.

Nikhil: Added merge note: wait for QA smoke + ops-bot preview, then merge. Thanks for the rapid reviews!
